eyebrow: The rule that let it through
caption: Lesson 10's exact code -- bare @dp.expect defaults to warn: log it, keep the row.

eyebrow: Proof, from the pipeline's own event log
code:
SELECT exp.name, exp.passed_records, exp.failed_records
FROM event_log(TABLE(harborview.silver.claims_clean)),
     LATERAL VIEW explode(
       details:flow_progress:data_quality:expectations) t AS exp
WHERE event_type = 'flow_progress'
  AND exp.name = 'valid_claim_amount'
ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1;
-- failed_records: 14 -- kept, every one
caption: Warn was doing exactly what it was told: count the violation, don't block it.
